leads.title: Call-back list
leads.intro: Customers who asked about a price or a booking and have no appointment
leads.emptyHint: There are no qualifying conversations in this period.
leads.truncated: The export reached the 5,000-row limit. Choose a shorter period for the remaining rows.
leads.crmNote: This is a filtered view of your conversations, not a CRM.
leads.safetyNote: The file contains customer handles and the text of their last question. Keep it safe and delete it when you no longer need it (KVKK).
leads.classificationNote: Only conversations the assistant classified as price or booking questions, including agent replies referencing pricing facts, are listed. Conversations handled outside the assistant or without these signals are not.

reports.title: Daily report
reports.intro: A summary of what happened on one day. Tap any number to see the records behind it.
reports.emptyHint: When there are messages, approvals or posts, the report summarises them here.
reports.noItems: There are no records behind this number

guarantee.title: Never an invented number
guarantee.hint: The assistant may only quote prices, hours and contact details from facts you verified. Each reply that is sent is checked, including the ones you write yourself.
guarantee.alert: Open the number to see which replies. Check them and correct the fact or the wording.

metrics.native_replies: Replies given in the Instagram app
metrics.unanswered_open_now: Open conversations waiting for a reply (now)
metrics.content_scheduled_next_24h: Posts scheduled for the next 24 hours
metrics.agent_approved_v1: Assistant effects verified after human approval

reports.evidenceUnavailable: The detail records for this older report were not saved. You can generate a new report if its sources are still available.

missed.title: Missed-customer report
missed.intro: What your assistant did for customers who wrote outside your opening hours. Tap a number to see the conversations behind it.
missed.simulatedNote: Demo and simulated messages are never counted here.
missed.needsHours: Add your verified opening hours to see this number.
missed.empty: No customer messages to report for this week
missed.emptyHint: When customers write, this page shows how many wrote after hours and what your assistant answered.

metrics.follow_up_replies: Customers who wrote back after a follow-up
metrics.after_hours_price_answers: Price questions the assistant answered outside opening hours
metrics.answered_questions: Price and booking questions the assistant answered
metrics.first_reply_median_minutes: Median time to the first reply

estimate.title: Estimated value of those answers
estimate.formula: {{questions}} price questions answered after hours × {{rate}} conversion × {{price}} median verified price = {{amount}}
estimate.rateNote: {{rate}} is a deliberately low planning rate, not something we measured. Your real result may be lower or higher.
estimate.medianOf: The median is taken over {{count}} verified prices.
estimate.hoursMissing: Your opening hours are not verified yet, so we cannot tell which messages came after hours. Only counts are shown, with no lira amount.
estimate.noPrice: There is no verified price in lira yet. Only counts are shown, with no lira amount.
